# The Trail of the Human Serpent Is Over Everything

The trail of the human serpent is thus over everything.[^1] Truth independent; truth that we FIND merely; truth no longer malleable to human need; truth incorrigible, in a word; such truth exists indeed superabundantly--or is supposed to exist by rationalistically minded thinkers; but then it means only the dead heart of the living tree, and its being there means only that truth also has its paleontology and its 'prescription,' and may grow stiff with years of veteran service and petrified in men's regard by sheer antiquity.[^2] But how plastic even the oldest truths nevertheless really are has been vividly shown in our day by the transformation of logical and mathematical ideas, a transformation which seems even to be invading physics.[^3] The ancient formulas are reinterpreted as special expressions of much wider principles, principles that our ancestors never got a glimpse of in their present shape and formulation.[^4]

[^1]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#The Formation of New Beliefs]] "The trail of the human serpent is thus over everything."
